ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Sivoov measures your run's distance and time, even with the screen locked, and plays the announcements at the right places on the course.
ios.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Sivoov keeps measuring your run with the screen locked, phone in your pocket.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Sivoov takes your start selfie, to put you in the race photos afterwards.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Sivoov sends the selfies you pick to put you in the race photos.
